title: docs(skills): drop the retired seed modes, name Seed.locale / fallback / dependsOn, and stop teaching array order as load order
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1XdbbGasMNVx41tq3hZKV4)_
Fixes #34798
Fixes #35070
Fixes #34277

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 技能的 `references/seeds.md` 不再把已退役的 seed 模式 `insert` / `replace` 当作可用模式来教，改成一句"两者被拒收，改用复合 `externalId`（或 `'id'`）"；字段表补上 `locale`、`fallback`、`dependsOn` 三行；关系一节改为"加载顺序由 lookup 决定，数组顺序只用来打破平局"，并教 `dependsOn` 及其整批拒收的三种情形。`objectstack-platform` SKILL.md 的 Seed Data 段只列 `ignore` / `upsert` / `update`。eval 加两例（复合键换法、`fallback`）。
- 为什么改：照技能写种子的 AI 会写出加载器拒收的 `insert` / `replace` 数据集；按数组顺序排父子在加载器里不起作用；`locale` / `fallback` 已上线但技能没教。
- 风险与回滚：只改对外发布的技能文字与 eval，无代码。`seeds.md` 先删同文件重复内容，余额 +13 token 按实测抬上限；platform SKILL.md 下调 15 token。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`（模式表下的退役句、关系一节新增的 `dependsOn` 段）；`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 的 seeds.md 行注释；`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` 的 30、31 两例。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 seeds.md 1759/1759、platform SKILL.md 6148/6148 均通过；`git grep -nE "mode: '(insert|replace)'" skills/` 无输出。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 属 Tier H 受治理面，席位核对后请批准合入。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`:

- **#34798.** The import-mode table drops the `insert` and `replace` rows, and the best-practice table drops the `replace` row. One sentence under the table replaces them, worded from the refusal message (`SEED_MODE_RETIRED_FIX`, `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`) of the merged retirement (f7960893c): both are refused because every replay re-inserted each record; with no single natural key, keep the default mode and set a composite `externalId` (`['team', 'project']`), or `'id'` when the records carry their own ids. The `externalId` row now says "(or field list) every mode matches on", since no unkeyed mode is left. "Never use `id`" now applies to generated UUIDs, so it no longer contradicts the `'id'` conversion.
- **#35070.** The field table names `locale` and `fallback`. The wording follows 7f6197ca36, trimmed to fit: `fallback` is `true` on ONE `locale` set per object and also loads for a locale no set names.
- **#34277.** Re-read against `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` as d10f652f1 left it.
  - The quick start's `// parents first` comment is gone.
  - The relationship section now says lookups order the load: a child loads after its parent however the array lists them, and array order only breaks ties.
  - A new paragraph teaches `dependsOn` with object names, for a `beforeInsert` hook that reads a seeded object no lookup links to. A name that is the dataset's own object, one no dataset of the load seeds (misspelt, or scoped out by `env`/`locale`), or a cycle refuses the whole load, and nothing is written.
  - The field table gains a `dependsOn` row, and the "parent → child in the exported array" best-practice row is deleted.

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, Seed Data passage only: the mode list is `ignore` default · `upsert` · `update`. On `bc75bcdbc` it listed `insert` and `replace` at :377, which a grep for `mode: 'insert'` cannot find.

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`:

- Case 4's expected output said "parents first". It now says lookups, not array order, order the load.
- New case 30: a junction table loaded once. The expected answer is a composite `externalId` under the default mode, and `'insert'` / `'replace'` are `must_not_contain`.
- New case 31: a `zh-CN` set plus an English `fallback: true` set, for a `de-DE` organization.
- Both new cases sit right after case 4. Appended at the end, they conflicted with draft #34964, which also appends there.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: row notes and values for the two files.

## Token budget

The standing ruling, verbatim: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068, letter B).

`seeds.md` paid first by deleting restatement in the same file:

- three best-practice rows that restated the `externalId`, mode and `env` passages;
- the `upsert` re-assert clause, which restated the mode table;
- "no other mode updates a matched row";
- "Natural keys remain the portable default".

Arithmetic in bytes: the cuts take 6984 down to 6570 (−414), and the new teaching adds +466, for 7036 bytes. ceil(7036 / 4) = 1759. Headroom was 0, so the ceiling moves 1746 → 1759 (+13), the measured remainder, pinned AT the measurement.

`objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` re-locks 6163 → 6148 at the landed count (24649 → 24591 priced bytes).

Skills readings (`skills/**` diff):

| Reading | Before (`bc75bcdbc`) | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `seeds.md` lines / tokens | 175 / 1746 | 178 / 1759 |
| `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` lines / tokens | 422 / 6163 | 422 / 6148 |
| eval json lines / tokens (measured, not ratcheted) | 255 / 5938 | 275 / 6406 |
| all `SKILL.md` lines (package sum) | 4833 | 4833 |
| whole bundle tokens (ratchet's `bundle total`) | 270984 | 271450 |

The bundle's +466 tokens are eval fixtures (+468). Authored text nets −2.

## Tests

No package code changes, so no package build or test is owed. The verification is the gates listed below.

Done-when for #34798, with a control leg on the same tree:

- `git grep -nE "mode: '(insert|replace)'" skills/` exits 1 on HEAD.
- The control `git grep -nE "mode: 'upsert'" skills/` exits 0.
- The same done-when grep also exits 1 on `bc75bcdbc`. It could not see the table-form teaching (`` `insert` `` in a table cell, the platform mode list).
- The broader `` git grep -nE '`(insert|replace)`' `` over the two files hits 4 lines on `bc75bcdbc` and 1 on HEAD. The one HEAD hit is the refusal sentence.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's done-when grep was already empty on `main` before this PR. It misses the teaching it targets, because that teaching was written as table cells and a mode list, not as `mode: 'insert'`. The broader reading above is the effective check.
- The retired-mode sentence follows the spec's refusal text (`SEED_MODE_RETIRED_FIX`) and keeps its `'id'` arm. As a result, the `externalId` section's "Never use `id`" now covers generated UUIDs only.
- `seed-mode-insert-replace-retired` (the D3 migration entry) carries the same judgement. The skill text does not link to it, because an author meets the refusal message first.

## Verification

All local readings are at head `66f76e140`.

<details><summary>Derived gate list: 69 families, 65 run (exit 0), 4 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 69 commands for the 5 changed paths.
- 65 of them exited 0. Among them:
  - `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: seeds.md 1759 / 1759, platform SKILL.md 6148 / 6148. `--self-test` also passes.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs` and `check:skill-served-sections`.
  - `pnpm check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:published-files`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`.
  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: "2249 cases pass", exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`: exit 0 after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock. Before that build it exited 3, prerequisite not met.
- 4 families are NOT MEASURED: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. Each exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) because it needs the whole workspace `dist/`. This diff touches no package source. CI's build carries them.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE` (every line `CMD :: exit N`): "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Overlap</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD --pr=35309,34964`: VERDICT clean exit 0.
- Plain `--branch=HEAD` run: VERDICT clean exit 0 against `origin/main` and #35309, #35302, #35300, #35129, #34964.
- A first placement of the eval cases at the end of the array conflicted with #34964. That version was never pushed. The cases were moved to follow case 4.

</details>
